behaviors_asserted: getPath() runs the path through decodeURI before routing
RegExpRouter compiles a wildcard to ONLY_WILDCARD_REG_EXP_STR = '.*' and TAIL_WILDCARD_REG_EXP_STR = '(?:|/.*)'
In JavaScript, '.' never matches a line terminator unless the 's' flag is set
Named-parameter patterns use LABEL_REG_EXP_STR = '[^/]+' which matches line terminators (so named params are not affected)
SmartRouter selects a router on the first request and only moves on when add() throws UnsupportedPathError
